note: Enhanced PR Freelance scrape — 7-day window (2026-05-20 → 2026-05-27). Sources: agency career pages verified live this run (Lambert by LLYC, Sharon Merrill Advisors, JCIR, InspIR Group, Group Gordon), plus Google/Bing-indexed LinkedIn/Indeed/ZipRecruiter/Glassdoor results, O'Dwyer's directory, Clutch.co IR/Financial PR rankings. Search clusters covered: freelance PR / PR consultant; communications & media-relations consultant (contract/freelance); fractional/interim communications; outsourced/agency-overflow/white-label PR; earned-media consultant / publicist contractor; pre-IPO & public-company IR consulting. Deduplicated against pr-freelance-scrape and daily-scrape reports 2026-04-30 → 2026-05-26. Skipped repeats already captured in prior runs, including: Peregrine Communications, Lowe Group, Sondhelm Partners, Avaans Media, Water & Wall Group, StreetCred PR, Forefront Communications, Hello Human, Gasthalter & Co, Prosek Partners, KCSA Strategic Communications, JConnelly, FiComm Partners, The James Collective, Peppercomm, Mission North, Bospar, BerlinRosen, Highwire PR, Antenna Group, Dukas Linden, Method Communications, M Booth, H/Advisors, Cardinal Communications, Haven Tower Group, Conway Communications, FINN Partners, Crackle PR, Edelman Smithfield, Gregory FCA/BackBay, Infinite Global, The Work Crowd, William Mills Agency, Caliber Corporate Advisers, 5WPR, Cognito Media, Vested, Inkhouse, Reputation Management Consultants, MACIAS PR (intern-heavy, not freelance-fit). This run surfaces FIVE NEW financial/IR-comms firms with live, verified hiring/capacity signals — two strong fits with explicit live reqs (Lambert by LLYC, Sharon Merrill Advisors), one always-on senior-recruiting IR boutique (JCIR), one senior-led IR/ESG plug-in shop (InspIR Group), and one corporate PR firm with a finance/law practice and a live (non-PR) leadership req (Group Gordon). Note on intent: Lambert is the cleanest signal of the week — a Top-10 financial/IR practice with an open IR analyst req on a real apply portal (lambert.applytojob.com). The other four are senior-to-senior cold/overflow plays. Quality over quantity — 5 vetted leads, all with a live careers/job URL for Mark to review.
